title: Error event, v1 (server SDKs)
description: One captured error, as a server SDK sends it: POST /v1/errors {"events": [<this>, …]} (at most 100, gzip with Content-Encoding: gzip), Authorization: Bearer <server secret>. Scrub personal data before sending; the service scrubs again. The id is minted by the SDK, so the reference a person quotes (its last 8 hex) exists before the service has the event; sending it again is harmless.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 with milliseconds and offset. A future one is placed at now; one older than the project keeps events is refused.

exceptions.description: The exception and its previous ones, outermost first.

frames.description: Newest first. in_app marks the host's own code: grouping keys on the top in-app frame.

transaction.description: The route, job or command that was running.

request_url.description: Path and query keys only, never values.

request_id.description: The request's id as the host's log lines carry it (mybeast/logs-laravel's, else the request's X-Request-Id from a proxy; a queued job's is the one of the request that queued it), so the issue page opens exactly its lines in Logs. One that does not fit is left off; the event still goes in.

subject.description: The person's id in the host. Never a name or an e-mail.

internal.description: Staff, demo or test account: never counted or alerted about.

fingerprint.description: The host's own grouping, instead of the service's.

context.description: Free-form, at most 64 KB as JSON. Known keys: runtime, breadcrumbs [{at, category, message, data?}], request {route, uri, action, params, fields, files, kind}, job, recording {id, at_ms?}, tags {string: string}.
